headline: Best worker passive skills in Palworld
title: Best Worker Passive Skills in Palworld | Artisan, Work Slave, Serious | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want faster base workers in Palworld? Look for these passive skills. Serious gives plus twenty percent work speed. Work Slave gives plus thirty percent, but lowers attack, which doesn't matter at home. Artisan gives plus fifty percent. Remarkable Craftsmanship gives plus seventy five percent. Lucky adds work speed and combat stats. And Insomnia stops a Pal from sleeping, so it works through the night. Breed them together for the perfect worker. Comment your best worker!
description: Best worker passives in Palworld: Serious (+20% work speed), Work Slave (+30%, -30% attack), Artisan (+50%), Remarkable Craftsmanship (+75%), Lucky, and Insomnia for night shifts.
